newsitem.title: UK: Algeria agrees cheaper Saharan for lifter - trade.
newsitem.headline: Algeria agrees cheaper Saharan for lifter - trade.

text.p: A lifter of Algerian Saharan Blend has agreed a contract value at "just below" a 40-cent premium to benchmark Dated Brent for July, a trader said on Thursday.
"Let's call it done at just below 40 cents," the trader said without elaborating.
The level, agreed in talks in London with Algerian oil company Sonatrach, appears in line with recent market talk which forecast July values in the upper 30s.
Most lifters had been bidding in the low 30s, while Sonatrach reportedly offered around +45.
There was no immediate indication of whether other lifters had agreed numbers. The June price was 60/62 cents over Dated Brent.
